newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran not to allow Bonn envoy back for now.
newsitem.headline: Iran not to allow Bonn envoy back for now.

text.p: Iran's spiritual leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei has instructed the Foreign Ministry not to allow the German ambassador to return to Tehran for now or to send back Iranian envoys to European states, the official news agency IRNA said on Wednesday.

"The supreme leader ordered the Iranian Foreign Ministry not to allow the German ambassador to Tehran to return for a period of time. The leader also instructed the Foreign Ministry not to rush in sending back Iranian ambassadors to their respective missions in the EU member states," IRNA said.
